name: PLATO — flooded crater floor

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 123 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: A lava-flooded crater floor ringed by massifs; one of the smoothest large surfaces on the nearside.

blurb: A lava-flooded crater floor ringed by massifs, and one of the smoothest large surfaces on the nearside.
